children: Amid the market volatility, four restaurant and snack stocks are holding up better than Bitcoin and Nvidia.
Over the past 6 months, Cheesecake Factory shares alone gained more than 70%, while Nvidia fell by double digits.
Which Snack Stocks Outran the Bitcoin Price and Nvidia?
Cheesecake Factory climbed 72.86% over six months as of Friday’s close. The restaurant chain has also more than doubled over the past year.
Wingstop rose 20.47% in the same period. Still, the chicken wing chain remains down more than a third on a 12-month basis.
Krispy Kreme added 14.25%, helped by a 31% jump on Thursday. The donut maker had lifted its full-year revenue outlook a day earlier.
Monster Beverage gained 8.22% over six months. Over 12 months, the energy drink maker is up more than a third.

image.alt: Bitcoin price vs snack stocks and Nvidia over six months

children: By comparison, the Bitcoin price landed near the bottom of the ranking. Only Nvidia did worse, with a loss of more than 12%.

children: Crypto stocks had already struggled before the midterms. Shares of Coinbase, Circle, and Robinhood have fallen 40% to 56% in a stealth bear market. Angel investor Jason Calacanis has even predicted a Bitcoin crash to $57,000.
